scope: All shared workspace user files, including all Users folders and the original Git working files. Excludes service Logs and this operation's RetiredComputeArchives staging directory. Original shared workspace remains intact.

archive_encryption.format: POSIX tar, gzip compressed, OpenSSL salted AES-256-CBC
archive_encryption.passphrase: Exact text of the named Key Vault secret; no secret value is retained in Git.
archive_encryption.restore_note: On the verified Mac OpenSSL3.6.5, use -saltlen 8 to read these archives. The original Linux encoder used an 8 byte salt. Decrypt then extract the gzip/tar into an isolated restore directory; do not use historical application files as release source.
archive_encryption.key_expiry: 31 days after verification; blob deletion eligibility begins 30 days after modification.
